name: The narrow way: the slot is hers, the ledges are yours
body: She is smaller and does something for you: she goes through the slot, pulls the lever and comes back. You can't use the slot, but you can climb the ledges over the wall alone, which is harder.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the prototype rooms and the crossing (#107, #108).

acceptance_criteria: She pulls the lever without being sent
You can pass alone over the ledges
